ai_summary: **Executive Summary**  Antony Waste Handling Cell Limited demonstrated operational resilience in Q2 FY27, with core revenue remaining broadly stable (~1% lower) and total tonnage growing slightly, driven by robust Collection & Transportation segment growth. This performance was achieved despite a material impact from the tragic July 2026 suspension of the PCMC Waste-to-Energy (WtE) facility, which ceased power generation and reduced processing volumes following an adjacent landfill collapse, with full functionality anticipated by December 2026. The incident highlights potential operational concentration risk and exposure to external environmental hazards impacting critical infrastructure.
